name: London
industries: Financial services, government delivery, technology scale-ups and the consulting firms serving them all drive certified hiring.
intro:
London's project market is really several markets sharing a skyline: banking and insurance programmes in the City and Canary Wharf, government delivery portfolios across Whitehall, tech scale-ups from Shoreditch to King's Cross, and the consultancies that staff all of them. Competition for delivery roles is international, day-rate contracting is a way of life, and certification is the currency both permanent and contract markets price openly — PMP for programme governance, Scrum credentials for digital delivery. Live online batches run year-round with sensible London timings — a full Saturday–Sunday weekend cohort plus a midweek Wednesday–Thursday option — so you train during comfortable local daytime hours; the schedule table below lists every upcoming date with its exact London start and finish. Afterwards we handle exam application guidance, full-length mocks, and trainer access for doubts until you clear.

London's project market is contract-heavy and credential-literate: banks, insurers and government programs source delivery talent through frameworks where certification affects both shortlisting and day rate. Permanent roles in the City and Canary Wharf lean the same way — a recognized credential is often the filter between a phone screen and silence. The course runs live online across two consecutive days in UK hours, so there is no venue trek across zones one to six and no annual leave burned. London compensation for certified project professionals has its own gravity; the sourced entries in the salary table below keep your numbers current and defensible. The employer list shows the finance-consulting-public-sector spread hiring here, and programmes needing certified delivery pods can use private cohorts.

faq.q: What are the class timings in London?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM UK, which is 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM GMT+1 in London. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in London?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in London. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from United Kingdom?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in United Kingdom and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in London sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in United Kingdom accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.
